HEADINGS 28 Englishrangni Americao Songdongani:_1 29 30 Rowan 31 Timur Jakora 32 Mose 33 Shah Jehan: I 34 35 Sagal 36 Miranda 37 Gisik Gnanggipa Ri- chardni Agana 38 Franceo Dakgrikaona A'chikrangni Re'angani 39 Franceni Dakgrikramo A chikrangni Kam Ka'a: I 40 41 Simano Atchia --- Page 7 --- PORAIANI KITAP IV Lesson I: Duke Aro Matchuko Moanggipa Bisa Changaso saksa duke matchu bima mangsako bree, uko sal gipino moangchina bi'sa saksao don- angaha.
Sal gipino, ua bi'sa matchuko dukeni nokona moangengachim.
Unon duke rama tong'- sao ua bi'sako gronge an'tangni, brebagipara matchu namchongmota, aro ua bi'sade ua mat- chuko saksan mobana ambrejaenga ine nikaha.

Unon ua bi'sa dukeko aganaha, 'Na'a ia matchuko moangna angna dakchakpabode.' ‘Na'asa man'oba man'jaoba saksan moangbo' ine duke aganchak- aha.Ta matchuko dukeni nokona_moangna na'a angna dakchakode, ia matchuko moangani gimin anga badita man'a, uni samsakode, anga nang'na on'genchim' ine bi'sa agantaiaha.
'Duke namgipa aro ka'sagipa mande ong'a, aro an'tangni nokona maikoba ra'angode, boksis on'rongako nikjama?" ine bi'sa aganaha.
Unon duke an'tangni matchuko moangna dakchakpaaha.
Uamang sakgnian mo- angaha.
Nokona sepangahaoa duke ja'man dongrik- emung, rama gipinko re'ange nokchina napange- mung,, uni, nokol saksako okame, matchuko mobagipa bi'sana on'china ine uni jako tangka gong: chi'bongako on'aha.
Bakbakan nokoni ong'katang- pile, rama tong'sao ua bi'sani noktangchina re'pil- baako sengsoaha.
'Duke nang'na paisako on'ata- hama?' ine duke aganaha.
Oe, iara maisa, ha, nang'ni palko ra'boha' ine bir'sa agane una ana dokko on'aha.
'Duke nang'na anna chi'gnikosan --- Page 8 --- GARO READER IV on'aiahane?' ine duke singaha.
‘Oe, inditara chu'- ongjama?
ian bang'ahake, ine bi'sa aganchakaha.
TOe, chu'onga chu'ongade, indiba dukede nang'- nadeindita mangmangde on'atjaenggen, re'emung sing'e nitaina' ine Duke aganaha.
'Re'angjaha eba angade, ian chu'ongaha, maina nalis ka'a gita ukoa?' ine bi'sa aganchakaha.
'Nalis ka'a ong'ja mangja, ang baksa re'bo, hai,' ine duke aganaha.
Nokona sokangon duke gam'bee do'gacholni gantiko salataha.
Maisa, na'ade gantiko gam'bee salata, tango ka'onangosai!
ine bi'sa aganaha.
Bakbakan saksa nokol ong-katbaaha.
Nokni pilak nokolrang sarao tom'dakbachina ine duke agan- ataha.
Unon pilakan re'batokahaoa, 'Badia mande nangna ana chigniko on'aha, mesokbo bi'sa ine duke aganaha.' Unon ba'ra gipokko gandapgipa dosko ka'sapae watpabo' ine nokol a'ao ga'ake dukeo mol'molaha.
'Na'a nang'ni kamoni chelang- genaha' ine duke aganaha.
Iarang ong'engmitingo bi'sade namen kenbee mamungkoba aganna chang- japilaha.
Unon aditani ja'manosa.' Na'an duke chong'motma?
Angni nang'ko matchu moatani gimin, na'a angko ka'onangjawama?', ine bi'sa sing'aha.
'Oe, angan duke, anga nang'ko mamu- ngba ka'onangja, indiba nang'ni bebe dakachi namgijagipa mandeko bikotna man'ahani gimin anga kusi ong'beaha' ine duke aganaha.
--- Page 9 --- GAROREADERIV Lesson 2: Gisik Gnanggipa Montri Sakbri Benares songjinmao donggipa saksa rajao gisik gnangbegipa montri sakbri gnangchim., Chang.
sao raja mainiba gimin an'tangni raiotrangni kosako' jrimgipa kajinako bariatna, dakon, ua montri sakbri uandake dakjachina rajako bengaha.
Uni gimin raja namen ka'onangbee ua montri sakbrini pilak gam aro kamkoba ra'seke uamangko a'rikataha.
Montri sakbrian damsan ku'monge Benaresoni re'angmitingo ramao.
uamangna.
skang, skang re'sogipa ut mangsani ja'kolko nikaha.
Uamang sakbrian ua utni gimin agangrike re'angengachim.
Unon saksa badinggipa uamangona re'bae, an'- tangni utko gimaataha ine uamangna aganaha.
Unon saksa montri aganaha 'Nang'ni utarajakra- chini mikron mikkelengaba?' Sakgipin aganaha, Ki'meba kan'dikbeakonba?' Gitamgipa aganaha Fa'aba samsa koraba?' Bon'kamgipa _aganaha.
"Okba saengake uara?' Chinga pilakan uko nikbakuja, indiba ia an'chengo chinga ja'kolko na'simanga angna baten aganna changbatake, na'simang nikchongmoten.
pale ra'chongmotaha.
Anga na'simangko rajao nalis ka'gen' ine badinggipa ka'onange aganaha.
Indaken ua dakabadakbebeaha.

Raja ua montri sakbriko bebeko aganjaode patoko dongen ine kenate aganaha, 'Na'siming ua utko mamung saloba nikkujaode maikaisa uan ja'kora, kana, ki'me kan'dika aro ok saa ine aganna man'- aha?' 'Ja'a samgitamni jakolkosan anga mong3ong --- Page 10 --- GARO READER IV nikaha; uni gimin ja'a samsade jakoral' ine anga chanchia ine montri saksa aganaha.

"Rama samtangtangchi  samsi chagiparangni, gisepo re'angmitingo ut mongsongde rama jakasichini samrangkosan chiksote cha'angaha, rama jakrachi- kode mamungkoba cha'jaha; uni gimin uan jakra- chini mikron kana ong'a ine anga chanchia' ine ja'kol dingtang dingtang ong'e, an'chi tingtotako nikaha, aro uko tampi chikarangni an'chi gita nika; uni gimin ua utni ki'me ro'jani giminsan ua be'en gimikn; tampiko dokponge a'rikna man'jae, tampi- rang uko indake chikaha ine anga chanchia' ine gitamgipa montri aganaha.

"Utni ja'kolko nion uni jak samgnini ja'kol badita tu'a, uni ja'a samgni namgipani ja'kolara indita tu'ja ine anga nikaha; uni gimin ja'ara be'enni ning'o maiba saknaachi sal- rikako man'ani giminsa, bilonge ga'na man'ja ine ine brigipa montri aganaha.
Iarangko knaon raja an'tangni montri sakbrini gisik gnanganini gimin aiao inmanpilaha.
Aro, 'Raiotrangni kosako angni mangsonga gita jrim- gipa kajanako gatjana na'simangni bengara nam- gninasa ong'chongmota' ine raja aganaha.
Ua jrim- gipa kajinako rang'san galpile, uamango kema bi'e, uamangko kamtangtango donpilaha, aro pangnan uamangni nama skianiko ra'chake kamko ka'angna ku'rachakaha.
